replacements.old: - [ ] Require matched grammar twins that remove the predicted mechanism without changing irrelevant search capacity.
replacements.new: - [x] Require matched grammar twins that remove the predicted mechanism without changing irrelevant search capacity. — ✅ #859 `gmi-833-d-controls-v1` R1: mechanism-removal twins must preserve candidate/effective capacity, depth, non-target primitive inventory, task/ecology/evaluator, search budget/tie/stopping and resource schema; unmatched-depth, non-removal and compensating-macro hostiles fail closed.

replacements.old: - [ ] Require alternate encodings of the same semantics.
replacements.new: - [x] Require alternate encodings of the same semantics. — ✅ #859 R2: at least two syntactically disjoint encodings must agree after canonical projection to protected behavior, raw resource vectors and property labels; deleted-candidate and changed-resource pseudo-remints emit `ENCODING_NOT_SEMANTICALLY_EQUIVALENT`.

replacements.anchor: # D. Architecture-prior taxonomy and no-smuggling standard
replacements.new: - [x] Require alternate search algorithms. — ✅ #859 R3: distinct exact-enumeration and admissible branch-and-bound procedures agree on the registered scientific conclusion with separate search-cost/certification evidence; an incomplete early-stop search that selects the wrong semantic conclusion emits `SEARCH_SENSITIVE`.

replacements.new: - [x] Require alternate resource scalarizations / Pareto analysis. — ✅ #859 R4: raw Pareto set is computed before scalar scores and three positive scalarizations are exercised. Candidate identity reverses across compute/memory prices while the protected property is invariant across the full Pareto set; universal candidate-winner wording therefore fails while the property-level claim remains robust.
